europe_now.title: Mass Shooting in Poland
europe_now.summary: Authorities launched a terrorism probe following a mass shooting incident in Kraków that resulted in multiple fatalities. Additional bodies were subsequently discovered at the suspect's residence as the investigation continued.

sources.headline: Poland launches terrorism probe into mass shooting in Krakow

europe_now.title: Energy Infrastructure Strikes in Ukraine
europe_now.summary: Recent military strikes conducted by Russia caused significant power outages affecting hundreds of thousands of residents in eastern Ukraine. The disruption targeted regional energy infrastructure, plunging large areas into darkness.

sources.headline: Russian strikes leave 600,000 in the dark in eastern Ukraine

top_stories.title: Attacks on Ukrainian Infrastructure
top_stories.summary: Russian military strikes impacted eastern Ukraine, leaving hundreds of thousands of people without electricity. The raids severely damaged local power networks in the region.
